# larm_alert_channel (Resource)

Manages a Larm alert channel — a destination that monitor outages and recoveries are dispatched to.

The provider supports 13 channel types (`webhook`, `slack`, `discord`, `email`, `ilert`, `incident_io`, `grafana_irm`, `mattermost`, `pagerduty`, `pushover`, `teams`, `ntfy`, `telegram`). Each type has its own typed configuration block — exactly one block must be set, and it must match the `type` attribute.

**Notes:**

- **SMS channels are not supported by the provider.** Phone numbers require out-of-band confirmation; manage SMS channels via the Larm dashboard.
- **Channel configuration is never refreshed from the API.** Config fields hold secrets and are intentionally write-only on the wire. Terraform keeps the values you supplied in state; out-of-band edits to a channel's config in the dashboard will not be detected.
- **Changing `type` forces replacement.** Different channel types have different config shapes.
- **After `terraform import`, the typed config block must be re-declared in HCL.** The first apply after import sends the declared config to the API, which is a no-op if it matches what is already stored.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "larm_alert_channel" "webhook" {
  name = "Ops Webhook"
  type = "webhook"

  webhook = {
    url = "https://ops.example.com/larm-alerts"

    headers = {
      Authorization = "Bearer ${var.webhook_token}"
    }
  }
}

resource "larm_alert_channel" "slack" {
  name = "Slack #alerts"
  type = "slack"

  slack = {
    integration_id = var.slack_integration_id
    channel_id     = "C0123456789"
    channel_name   = "#alerts"
  }
}

resource "larm_alert_channel" "discord" {
  name = "Discord"
  type = "discord"

  discord = {
    webhook_url = var.discord_webhook_url
  }
}

resource "larm_alert_channel" "email" {
  name = "Engineering Team"
  type = "email"

  email = {
    recipients = ["oncall@example.com", "sre@example.com"]
  }
}

resource "larm_alert_channel" "ilert" {
  name = "ilert"
  type = "ilert"

  ilert = {
    api_key = var.ilert_api_key
  }
}

resource "larm_alert_channel" "incident_io" {
  name = "incident.io"
  type = "incident_io"

  incident_io = {
    alert_source_url = "https://api.incident.io/v2/alert_events/http/abc123"
    api_token        = var.incident_io_api_token
  }
}

resource "larm_alert_channel" "grafana_irm" {
  name = "Grafana IRM"
  type = "grafana_irm"

  grafana_irm = {
    integration_url = var.grafana_irm_integration_url
  }
}

resource "larm_alert_channel" "mattermost" {
  name = "Mattermost"
  type = "mattermost"

  mattermost = {
    webhook_url = var.mattermost_webhook_url
  }
}

resource "larm_alert_channel" "pagerduty" {
  name = "PagerDuty"
  type = "pagerduty"

  pagerduty = {
    integration_key = var.pagerduty_integration_key
  }
}

resource "larm_alert_channel" "pushover" {
  name = "Pushover"
  type = "pushover"

  pushover = {
    user_key  = var.pushover_user_key
    api_token = var.pushover_api_token
  }
}

resource "larm_alert_channel" "teams" {
  name = "Microsoft Teams"
  type = "teams"

  teams = {
    webhook_url = var.teams_webhook_url
  }
}

resource "larm_alert_channel" "ntfy" {
  name = "ntfy"
  type = "ntfy"

  ntfy = {
    server_url = "https://ntfy.sh"
    topic      = "my-larm-alerts"
  }
}

resource "larm_alert_channel" "telegram" {
  name = "Telegram"
  type = "telegram"

  telegram = {
    bot_token = var.telegram_bot_token
    chat_id   = "-1001234567890"
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Human-readable channel name.
- `type` (String) Channel type. One of `webhook`, `slack`, `discord`, `email`, `ilert`, `incident_io`, `grafana_irm`, `mattermost`, `pagerduty`, `pushover`, `teams`, `ntfy`, `telegram`. Changing this forces replacement.

### Optional

- `default_for_new_monitors` (Boolean) Whether new monitors should attach this channel by default. Defaults to `false`.
- `discord` (Attributes) Configuration for `discord` channels. Set when `type = "discord"`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--discord))
- `email` (Attributes) Configuration for `email` channels. Set when `type = "email"`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--email))
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the channel is enabled. Defaults to `true`.
- `grafana_irm` (Attributes) Configuration for `grafana_irm` channels. Set when `type = "grafana_irm"`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--grafana_irm))
- `ilert` (Attributes) Configuration for `ilert` channels. Set when `type = "ilert"`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ilert))
- `incident_io` (Attributes) Configuration for `incident_io` channels. Set when `type = "incident_io"`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--incident_io))
- `mattermost` (Attributes) Configuration for `mattermost` channels. Set when `type = "mattermost"`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--mattermost))
- `ntfy` (Attributes) Configuration for `ntfy` channels. Set when `type = "ntfy"`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ntfy))
- `pagerduty` (Attributes) Configuration for `pagerduty` channels. Set when `type = "pagerduty"`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pagerduty))
- `pushover` (Attributes) Configuration for `pushover` channels. Set when `type = "pushover"`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pushover))
- `slack` (Attributes) Configuration for `slack` channels. Set when `type = "slack"`. The Slack workspace must first be connected in the Larm dashboard; pass the resulting integration ID here. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--slack))
- `teams` (Attributes) Configuration for `teams` channels (Microsoft Teams). Set when `type = "teams"`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--teams))
- `telegram` (Attributes) Configuration for `telegram` channels. Set when `type = "telegram"`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--telegram))
- `webhook` (Attributes) Configuration for `webhook` channels. Set when `type = "webhook"`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--webhook))

### Read-Only

- `broken_at` (String) RFC3339 timestamp when the channel was last marked broken; null otherwise.
- `broken_reason` (String) Reason the channel is broken; null otherwise.
- `id` (String) Alert channel ID.
- `inserted_at` (String) RFC3339 creation timestamp.
- `updated_at` (String) RFC3339 last-update timestamp.

### Nested Schema for `discord`

Required:

- `webhook_url` (String, Sensitive) Discord webhook URL, in the form `https://discord.com/api/webhooks/{id}/{token}`.


<a id="nestedatt--email"></a>
### Nested Schema for `email`

Required:

- `recipients` (List of String) Email addresses to notify.


<a id="nestedatt--grafana_irm"></a>
### Nested Schema for `grafana_irm`

Required:

- `integration_url` (String, Sensitive) Grafana IRM integration webhook URL.


<a id="nestedatt--ilert"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ilert`

Required:

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) ilert alert source API key.


<a id="nestedatt--incident_io"></a>
### Nested Schema for `incident_io`

Required:

- `alert_source_url` (String) Alert source URL from incident.io. Must start with `https://api.incident.io/`.
- `api_token` (String, Sensitive) incident.io API token.


<a id="nestedatt--mattermost"></a>
### Nested Schema for `mattermost`

Required:

- `webhook_url` (String, Sensitive) Mattermost incoming-webhook URL.


<a id="nestedatt--ntfy"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ntfy`

Required:

- `server_url` (String) ntfy server URL (e.g. `https://ntfy.sh`).
- `topic` (String) ntfy topic name.


<a id="nestedatt--pagerduty"></a>
### Nested Schema for `pagerduty`

Required:

- `integration_key` (String, Sensitive) PagerDuty Events API v2 integration key (32-character lowercase hex).


<a id="nestedatt--pushover"></a>
### Nested Schema for `pushover`

Required:

- `api_token` (String, Sensitive) Pushover application API token.
- `user_key` (String, Sensitive) Pushover user (or group) key.


<a id="nestedatt--slack"></a>
### Nested Schema for `slack`

Required:

- `channel_id` (String) Slack channel ID (e.g. `C0123456789`).
- `channel_name` (String) Display name of the Slack channel (e.g. `#alerts`).
- `integration_id` (String) Identifier of the Slack OAuth integration in Larm.


<a id="nestedatt--teams"></a>
### Nested Schema for `teams`

Required:

- `webhook_url` (String, Sensitive) Microsoft Teams incoming-webhook URL.


<a id="nestedatt--telegram"></a>
### Nested Schema for `telegram`

Required:

- `bot_token` (String, Sensitive) Telegram bot token, in the form `123456789:ABCdef…`.
- `chat_id` (String) Numeric chat ID (e.g. `-1001234567890`) or channel username (e.g. `@alerts`).


<a id="nestedatt--webhook"></a>
### Nested Schema for `webhook`

Required:

- `url` (String) HTTPS endpoint to POST alerts to.

Optional:

- `headers` (Map of String, Sensitive) Additional HTTP headers to send with each request. Header values may contain bearer tokens, so the entire map is treated as sensitive.
- `payload_template` (String) Optional EEx template overriding the default alert payload.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import larm_alert_channel.webhook 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
